name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina Volkov’s passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood visits to local rally events outside Moscow. Witnessing the intricate dance between driver and machine sparked a fascination that led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, she gained experience in a Formula 3 team, honing her skills in data analysis and vehicle dynamics.

Irina is known for her meticulous approach to race engineering. She believes in a data-driven strategy, meticulously analyzing telemetry to optimize car setup and driver performance. While demanding, she fosters a collaborative environment, encouraging open communication between the driver and the mechanics. Her innovative approach to problem-solving, combined with her deep understanding of vehicle dynamics, makes her a valuable asset to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail during races.
physical.description: Irina has a focused and intense gaze, reflecting her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always carries a lucky wrench that belonged to her grandfather.
Insists on using a specific brand of Russian tea during race weekends.
Has a habit of muttering complex calculations under her breath.
